card.name: Start of specific drug and term names
card.fires_on: The first piece of certain long drug or medical terms, such as U in UGT1A1 or urotoxicity, ole in levoleucovorin, and se in sevoflurane.

modes.label: U- terms
modes.description: The letter U starting uro- words or UGT enzyme names.
modes.example: Dosage Modification for Concomitant Use with<< U>>GT1A1 Inhibitors Avoid

modes.label: Inside levoleucovorin
modes.description: The ole piece in the middle of levoleucovorin.
modes.example: inject no more than 16 mL (160 mg) of lev<<ole>>ucovorin solution intravenously

modes.label: Start of sevoflurane
modes.description: The se piece that begins sevoflurane.
modes.example: Known or suspected sensitivity to<< se>>voflurane or to other

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece of a drug name, such as po, ro or ry, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of certain long drug names, such as sevoflurane, levoleucovorin and urotoxicity.
